purpose: The ledger service manages financial entries and balances for wallet and payment services.

components.name: ledger-core
components.evidence: The ledger moves out of the payments monolith into its own service, ledger-core, with its own database, ledger-db (PostgreSQL), and its own event stream, ledger-events (Kafka).

components.name: ledger-db
components.evidence: The ledger moves out of the payments monolith into its own service, ledger-core, with its own database, ledger-db (PostgreSQL), and its own event stream, ledger-events (Kafka).

components.name: ledger-events
components.evidence: The ledger moves out of the payments monolith into its own service, ledger-core, with its own database, ledger-db (PostgreSQL), and its own event stream, ledger-events (Kafka).

flows.data: debit_account, credit_account, amount, currency and reference
flows.evidence: POST /v1/entries accepts debit_account, credit_account, amount, currency and reference.
ledger-core writes them to ledger-db and publishes a posted-entry event.
An event is published to ledger-events after the entry is committed.
GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/balance returns account_id, balance and currency.
POST /v1/entries/{entryId}/reversal accepts a reason and posts a cancelling entry.
